tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: a cool mist grey. Not cream; calm in office light and holds up outdoors on phones.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, sheets, the nav rail, the top bar and the phone tab bar.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Photo frames, read-only fields, segmented-control track, quiet notices.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders (decorative; never the only boundary of a control).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders (3.97:1 on card).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and figures on paper and card; also the text on a yellow plate (10.2:1 on plate-ground).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata: 6.9:1 on paper, 7.8:1 on card.

tokens.name: sapphire
tokens.usage: Action blue: primary buttons, links, focus ring. White on it 7.1:1. Never a status colour. (Name kept from Ratna so components stay compatible.)

tokens.name: sapphire-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed; emphasis text on sapphire-tint.

tokens.name: sapphire-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info notices, matched/deposit pills. Sapphire text on it 5.9:1.

tokens.name: on-sapphire
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sapphire and sapphire-strong.

tokens.name: overdue
tokens.usage: Overdue only: the one solid status chip (white text 6.6:1), the overdue card border and fleet tick; money going out. Never decorative.

tokens.name: overdue-tint
tokens.usage: Overdue row band and unmatched/open pill background (overdue text on it).

tokens.name: available
tokens.usage: Available chip text/icon on available-tint (5.5:1); money coming in.

tokens.name: available-tint
tokens.usage: Available chip and Paid pill background.

tokens.name: available-tick
tokens.usage: Available ticks in the fleet strip (graphic only, always beside a worded legend).

tokens.name: rented
tokens.usage: Rented chip text/icon on rented-tint and rented ticks. Charcoal, so blue stays the action colour.

tokens.name: rented-tint
tokens.usage: Rented chip background.

tokens.name: repair
tokens.usage: Under-repair chip text/icon on repair-tint (5.7:1).

tokens.name: repair-tint
tokens.usage: Under-repair chip background.

tokens.name: repair-tick
tokens.usage: Under-repair ticks in the fleet strip.

tokens.name: unavailable
tokens.usage: Temporarily-unavailable chip text/icon; the chip also takes a dashed border.

tokens.name: unavailable-tint
tokens.usage: Temporarily-unavailable chip background.

tokens.name: unavailable-tick
tokens.usage: Temporarily-unavailable ticks in the fleet strip.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Not-found, expiring, admin-pending: text/icon on warning-tint (6.3:1).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning band and pill background.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring on paper and card.

tokens.name: plate-ground
tokens.usage: The signature: the face of every number plate (PlateBadge, BrandMark) and the active rail/tab pill. Never a status, never a button, never a large area.

tokens.name: plate-ink
tokens.usage: Text and frame on plate-ground (10.2:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the page greeting or title on desktop.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles; the phone page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: අත්සන් කළ agreement එකේ photo එක දාන්න
styles.usage: Phone body text; 1.7 line height keeps Sinhala vowel signs clear.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, rail and tab labels, form labels. Buttons use 600. No letter-spacing, no capitals styling.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest text allowed: times, actors, notes.

styles.name: plate
styles.usage: Registration numbers on the yellow plate face. Gemunu Libre 600, the proposal’s display face.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Money, counts and times in Gemunu Libre 600 with tabular figures, so they read as a different voice from the words.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between touch targets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding; gap between cards on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; phone side margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; desktop page margin.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Plate badge, fleet ticks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, notices, rail items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, money blocks, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count badges and the phone centre action only.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Desktop navigation rail: icon above a visible label.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Desktop and phone top bar height.

tokens.name: nav-bottom
tokens.usage: Phone tab bar with the raised centre action.

tokens.name: thumb-row
tokens.usage: Vehicle thumbnail in compact rows.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only the phone centre action and open sheets. Cards use a border, never a shadow.
